from pathlib import Path
pdir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u079/system/state/workspace/programs'); pdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    horizontal = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    vertical = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Divider lines are the full-width/full-height uniform lines.
    rows = [r for r in horizontal if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in vertical if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    def spans(n, cuts):
        edges = [-1] + cuts + [n]
        return [(edges[i]+1, edges[i+1]) for i in range(len(edges)-1) if edges[i+1] > edges[i]+1]
    # Keep only uniform lines that are separators between regions, not whole-row content.
    r_spans = spans(h, rows)
    c_spans = spans(w, cols)
    div_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in cols}
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in div_colors)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    result = []
    for r0, r1 in r_spans:
        outrow = []
        for c0, c1 in c_spans:
            marks = sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
            outrow.append(1 if marks == 2 else background)
        result.append(outrow)
    return result
'''
(pdir/'task-9eacc57a.py').write_text(code)
exec(compile(code, str(pdir/'task-9eacc57a.py'), 'exec'),globals())
